name: Eltoromia
description: Eltoromia is a Surrey landscaping team building driveways, patios and paths, artificial grass, brickwork, fencing and gates, and full garden transformations for homes across Esher, Surrey and South West London.

hero.eyebrow: Landscaping and garden construction in Surrey
hero.title: Where gardens matter.
hero.intro: Twenty years of driveways, patios, decking, brickwork, fencing and full garden transformations across Esher, Surrey and South West London. Every photograph on this site is our own work.

story.title: A small team that does the groundwork properly.
story.body: Eltoromia is run by Jamie and works as a tight, hands-on crew rather than a chain of subcontractors. Twenty years of driveways, patios, brickwork, decking and fencing across Surrey and South West London means most of what we do is groundwork you never see: excavation, sub-bases, falls, edge restraint and drainage. Get those right and the surface on top holds its line for decades. We quote clearly, start when we say we will, keep the site tidy while we work and leave the garden clean.

mission: To build outdoor spaces that are still holding their line in twenty years, for homeowners who would rather have it done once and done properly.

values.title: The groundwork comes first
values.text: Excavation, sub-base, falls and edge restraint are where a driveway or patio is won or lost. We do not cut those corners to make a price look better.

values.title: One team, start to finish
values.text: The people who quote the job are the people who build it. A crew of two to ten on site, with no chain of subcontractors to chase.

values.title: Tidy sites, clear updates
values.text: Customers tell us the same two things most often: the garden was kept tidy throughout, and everything was explained before it happened.

team.name: Jamie
team.bio: Jamie quotes every job on site, sets the work out and stays on the tools through the build. He is named in most of our reviews, usually for explaining exactly what was going to happen before it happened.

process.title: Site visit and quote
process.text: We come out, look at access, levels, drainage and what the ground is actually made of, then talk through the options and what each one costs.

process.title: Excavate and prepare
process.text: Clearance, excavation, sub-base, falls and edge restraint. This is the part that decides whether the finish lasts, and it is the part that takes the time.

process.title: Build and finish
process.text: Paving, brickwork, decking, turf or fencing goes in, with the cuts, joints and edge details set out before anything is fixed down.

process.title: Clear down and hand over
process.text: Waste away, site washed down, and a walk round the finished garden with you before we leave.

cta.title: Thinking about a driveway, patio or a whole garden?
cta.text: Send over a few photos and a rough idea of what you want. We usually come back within four hours.
